metadata.description: 让 DSH 会话文字与 Markdown 表格适应侧栏之间的可用宽度。
metadata.name: dsh-conversation-reflow

paragraphs.text: 让 DSH 会话文字与 Markdown 表格适应侧栏之间的可用宽度。
Keep conversation text and Markdown table cells within the width available between sidebars. The plu
gin preserves font size and retains scrolling for content that still needs it.
The plugin uses DSH extension points and leaves with its bundle when disabled. It adds no tools, mod
el prompts, external requests, or conversation records.

- Install, use, develop, and publish
- MIT license
